en.intro: Kind-hearted, a little crazy, and a lot misunderstood, Luna Lovegood often finds herself popular amongst magical creatures, who will fight in her stead.
en.tips: Use low- and high-cost Spell Cards wisely to get the best Fantastic Beast for the current battle situation.

zh.name: 小天狼星·布莱克
zh.intro: 小天狼星勇敢而无畏的战斗风格，能鼓舞任何同伴发挥自己最大的潜力。
zh.tips: 适合搭配强力生物或辅助巫师队友

en.name: Sirius Black
en.intro: Anyone who witnesses Sirius Black's bravery on the battlefield will be inspired to perform their best.
en.tips: Best matched with powerful creatures or support teammates.

zh.name: 罗恩·韦斯莱
zh.intro: 以战场为棋盘，罗恩将用巫师棋的力量为你赢得胜利。
zh.tips: 适合搭配解场类型的法术，用棋子强化召唤物发动进攻。

en.name: Ron Weasley
en.intro: The battlefield is his chessboard. Ron, the undisputed chess master, will certainly prevail.
en.tips: Best used in conjunction with Spells that can wipe the field. Enhance your summons with pieces to gain an advantage.

zh.name: 金妮·韦斯莱
zh.intro: 骑上扫把，用快速冲刺突破中场限制，用球棍代替魔杖在决斗场打出漂亮的比分！
zh.tips: 普攻增益型回响，适配进攻型生物和普攻增益法术。

en.intro: Ginny zigzags across the field and flies into the opponent's half, proving that in a Duel, a bat can be just as effective as a Wand!
en.tips: Strengthens Basic Attacks. Ginny works best when combined with aggressive Summons and Basic Attack enhancing Spells.

zh.name: 阿不思·邓布利多

en.intro: Adds an Enhanced Card to your hand after spending a designated amount of MP. The Enhanced Card can be used to temporarily replace your current hand with 4 random spell cards, all with a fixed MP cost of 2.

zh.name: 米勒娃·麦格

zh.tips: 适合搭配可组合使用的咒语卡。

items: 手牌中加入一张可以无限使用、魔力值消耗固定为2的神奇生物卡，神奇生物卡初始为神奇小猪。

en.name: Echo of Luna Lovegood
en.desc:
An unlimited-use Creature Card has been added to your Deck, with a set MP Cost of 2. The Fantastic Beast Card starts with the <link=open_word_explain|13><u=0xffa146ff,1>Wild Boar</u></link>. The Fantastic Beasts are upgraded after using Spell Cards with a MP Cost of 3 or more<link=open_word_explain|15><u=0xffa146ff,1></u></link>. After the card reaches Max Level, there is a chance to Summon a <link=open_word_explain|14><u=0xffa146ff,1>Thestral</u></link>. Summoned Fantastic Beasts that have attacked 5 times will split once.
Fantastic Beast Card Attributes increase with average Deck Level and Echo Rarity.

details.title: Magical Creature Cards
items: An unlimited-use Creature Card with a set MP Cost of 2 will be added to your Deck. You will start with the Tebo Card.
Levelling up the Magical Creature Card to the Max MP (currently 7) will grant you a chance to summon a Thestral.
Every time you use a Spell Card with an MP Cost of 3 or higher, the Creature Card will be upgraded 1 time.

The creature summoned with the Magical Creature Card is adaptive and will split after 5 attacks. Summoned creatures can only split once.
The strength of the creatures will be based on the average Card Level of your Deck, the rarity of your current Echo, and your current Echo bonus.

items: 链接友方单位，每2秒为其提供<color=focus_dark>6%</color>伤害加成。

en.name: Echo of Sirius Black
en.desc:
<link=open_word_explain|17><u=0xffa146ff,1>Links</u></link> you to a nearby Ally Unit, giving them a 6% Damage Bonus every 1.5s. After stacking 3 times, if linked to a Wizard/Witch, you both gain an additional 18% Attack Speed and 20% Movement Speed. If linked to a Summon, the linked Ally Unit gains an additional 50% Attack Speed and 40% Movement Speed.
The Bonus effects are removed when the link is broken. Summons with fully stacked Bonuses will not lose the Bonuses when the link is broken but cannot be linked with again.

details.title: Establishing a Link
items: Establishes a link with a friendly unit, granting a stackable <color=focus_dark>6%</color> damage bonus every 2 seconds.
At 3 stacks, both you and the linked student (Time-Turner versions included) will gain an extra <color=focus_dark>25%</color> attack speed and 20% movement speed.
A non-student unit linked by this effect will receive an extra <color=focus_dark>50%</color> attack speed and 20% movement speed.

Breaking the link will remove all Bonuses received. When a Summon is granted all Bonus effects, the link will automatically break, allowing the Summon to keep the Bonuses for the rest of the fight. However, it cannot be linked again.

<link=open_word_explain|17><u=0xffa146ff,1>Links</u></link> you to a nearby Ally Unit, giving them a 7% Damage Bonus every 1.5s. After stacking 3 times, if linked to a Wizard/Witch, you both gain an additional 22% Attack Speed and 20% Movement Speed. If linked to a Summon, the linked Ally Unit gains an additional 60% Attack Speed and 40% Movement Speed.
When the link is broken, Attack Speed and Movement Speed Bonuses are lost immediately, but the Damage Bonus is lost stack by stack. Summons with Max Stacked Bonuses will not lose the Bonuses when the link is broken.

details.title: Link with a Student
items: Establishes a link with a friendly unit, granting a stackable <color=focus_dark>7%</color> damage bonus every 2 seconds.
At 3 stacks, both you and the linked student (Time-Turner versions included) will gain an extra <color=focus_dark>30%</color> attack speed and 20% movement speed.
A non-student unit linked by this effect will receive an extra <color=focus_dark>60%</color> attack speed and 20% movement speed.

Breaking the link will remove all Bonuses received. When a Summon is granted all Bonus effects, the link will automatically break, allowing the Summon to keep the Bonuses for the rest of the fight. However, it cannot be linked again.
